# inputs (sha256 first 12): h3_units.tsv f24716bad32d; h3_inventory.tsv 75bb8a75dc47; recurrent_sets.tsv 3c42f67cdd7a; 1_global_our_prior.tsv 68272e907b72; hgnc_complete_set.txt 69bb5722d5a4; primary_lists.json 44fb07b1d2e5; universes.json 25a477fc64ae; meta15_input_datasets.tsv (91 slots, 42 datasets)

# AUROC = P(a gene of the set outranks a gene of the rest of the ranked universe) + 0.5 P(tie); ranking = number of the lists that contain the gene (each list restricted to its own tested universe, fallback = core-80 brain union for units without one); null = joint random draws of the lists at their sizes (uniform: size fixed; DE prior: independent Bernoulli by DE-prior probability, as meta15_recurrent.py), P = (1+#sim>=obs)/(NPERM+1)

# per list: ranking = membership of the list (two levels), universe = the list's own tested universe, positives = the set genes in it; AUROC = (1 + hits/set_genes - (list_genes - hits)/(universe - set_genes))/2 = mean of the true-positive and true-negative rates; null from the same draws (list size varies in the DE-prior null)
